responsibility: Implements function-level RTL generation and per-function back-end state management. It owns the current function context (cfun), nested-function context stacking, allocation and cleanup of struct function data, creation of parameter and local-variable RTL, stack-slot and temporary allocation, prologue/epilogue tracking, function start/end expansion, return handling, and related RTL utility passes such as the asm-constraint matching pass that rewrites matched asm operands into reload-friendly form.
same_name_distinction: Implements the mutable per-function RTL-generation machinery and global/current-function state management such as cfun handling, stack-slot allocation, function start/end expansion, and related RTL passes; unlike gcc/function.h, which declares the per-function data structures and exported interfaces.
